fitEvidence.method: Fixed-scale rotation/translation fit to union of inherited footprints 1 and 12. Raster IoU is a shape score, not positional accuracy.
fitEvidence.v16: v15 fit composed with T_GIS and a measured snap to the NGII 2025 16-storey outline; horizontal scale kept at T_GIS.s (≈1).
fitEvidence.v16base: base shifted -0.21 m with the terrain change under the footprint

groundSource: 2025 survey contour interpolation; 20m display grid (not step surveyed)
